6. The bail plea of the petitioner was rejected on 08.12.2 .2023 by the learned trial Court.
Hence, the petitioner has approached this Court by filing the present bail application.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the plea of bail of the petitioner is not pending before any other Court, except the present one.
8. Taking into consideration the period of custody since 07.06.2023 and the nature of accusation, I am inclined to admit the petitioner on bail.

The prosecution is given liberty to move application before the Court below for cancellation of bail,
if the petitioner violates any of the conditions of the bail granted to him.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner is an accused in connection with  Jaipatna P.S. Case No.119 of 2023 corresponding to  C.T. Case No.155 of 2023 registered under Sections  376(2)(n)/376(2)(i)/493/417 of the IPC read with Section 92 of the Right of Person with Disability Act,
 2016 pending in the Court of Additional Sessions  Judge-cum-Special Judge, Bhawanipatna.
 4.
The prosecution case is that, the petitioner after  giving false assurance of marriage, kept physical  relationship with the informant/victim for which she  became pregnant.
The informant is a handicapped girl.
Thereafter, the petitioner refused to accept her as his wife.
Learned counsel for the State submits that during investigation, the statement of the victim, who was aged about 22 years then, has been recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. In her statement, she inter alia stated that she was in relationship with the petitioner and the petitioner promised her to get marry and taking a advantage of her, the petitioner kept physical relationship as a result of which she became pregnant.
opennyai_summary.decision:
6. The bail plea of the petitioner was rejected on 08.12.2 .2023 by the learned trial Court.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the plea of bail of the petitioner is not pending before any other Court, except the present one.
8. Taking into consideration the period of custody since 07.06.2023 and the nature of accusation, I am inclined to admit the petitioner on bail.
Hence, the petitioner be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it would deem just and proper, subject to the following additional conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever;
(ii) He shall not contact the victim or her family members;
(iii) He shall appear before the Court below on each date of trial;
Violation of any of the bail conditions shall entail cancellation of the bail granted to the petitioner.
The prosecution is given liberty to move application before the Court below for cancellation of bail,
if the petitioner violates any of the conditions of the bail granted to him.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
